instructions_en.title: How to Complete This Form
steps: This form tracks morning and evening transportation trips provided each day of the month. The form automatically calculates daily totals (maximum 2 per day) and the monthly total.
For each day of the month, check the boxes that apply:
Helpful Tip: The table covers dates 1-31 to accommodate all months. For months with fewer days, simply leave the extra dates unchecked.
Clear All Button: If you need to start over, use the "Clear All" button to uncheck all boxes at once.
Note: Your selections are saved automatically on this device as you work.
The form automatically calculates totals in two places:
Client Name: Enter the full name of the client receiving transportation services.
Month / Year: Select any day in the month you're reporting. This sets the month and year for all trip entries.
AM Trip Provided: Check this box if you provided a morning transportation trip on that date.
PM Trip Provided: Check this box if you provided an evening transportation trip on that date.
Total Trips Provided (0-2): This column automatically calculates based on your AM and PM selections. The maximum is 2 trips per day.

instructions_en.title: Daily Totals
steps: The Total Trips Provided column shows the sum of AM and PM trips for each day (displayed as 0, 1, or 2).

instructions_en.title: Trips by Day Section
steps: This section automatically creates a 31-row summary of all trips. You can add or remove rows using the + and - buttons if needed, though 31 rows are provided by default.

instructions_en.title: Monthly Total Trips
steps: At the bottom of the form, the Monthly Total Trips field displays the auto-calculated sum of all trips provided during the month. This value is automatically computed and should be between 0 and 62 trips.
Important: The total should usually equal AM + PM for each day combined across the month.
Note: This form stores your entries automatically on your device, so you can return to complete it later if needed.
Review the daily entries to ensure all transportation trips are accurately recorded.
Verify that the monthly total makes sense based on the number of days you provided service.
Confirm that the client name and month/year are correct.
Click Submit to finalize the form.
